payload.title: Show both dates in the newsroom and in packs
payload.description:
Feed card, Reference detail, Related cards (S2.9), idea Evidence sections and packs: "published <date> · added <date>", "published unknown" when null, with the precision (e.g. "published Oct 2026"). Screenshot review.
UI rules: Lucide icons; buttons + textarea, no dropdowns or popovers; one Accept/Reject vocabulary; a text label beside every mark (never colour alone); no AppSync subscriptions; screenshot review by Ryan on a local dev server before merging.
